purpose: silver_ourairports_airports is the cleaned reference table of 9,057 airports from the OurAirports bronze feed, one row per airport id, with typed coordinates, integer elevation, a boolean scheduled-service flag, and Airbyte capture columns removed. It feeds downstream geographic enrichment and airport lookup joins.
usage: Join on id (integer primary key) or on the alternate unique keys ident and iata_code. Use latitude_deg/longitude_deg as DOUBLE degrees and has_scheduled_service as a true/false flag. Consumers relying on icao_code, gps_code, municipality, or elevation_ft must handle nulls deliberately, and should treat local_code, home_link, and keywords as sparse optional attributes.
limitations: No rows were removed or imputed: elevation_ft is null on 3.7% of rows, icao_code on 13.7%, and local_code (63.7%), keywords (68.0%), and home_link (74.9%) are mostly empty. keywords remains an unparsed comma-separated text blob. Coordinate validity beyond the observed min/max ranges and the uniqueness of ident and iata_code as alternate keys are asserted from profile statistics and should be confirmed against the warehouse.
